item.title: 'So much potential': Durham relaunches effort to redevelop vacant police headquarters downtown
item.description: Despite multiple attempts to redevelop Durham's former police headquarters, plans have fallen through every time. But after sitting vacant for about eight years, the city is trying again.

item.title: Raleigh looks to continue improving road safety for drivers and pedestrians
item.description: Some of the greatest needs are along the busiest roadways in the city, with this plan prioritizing improvements along parts of Capital Boulevard, Poole Road, South Saunders Street and Rock Quarry Road.

item.title: Family, friend, Fayetteville community gather to remember firefighter who died in line of duty
item.description: Motorcycles rolled into an Aberdeen cemetery Tuesday, marking 26 years since Fayetteville Firefighter David Sharp II died in the line of duty. Each year, family, friends, and members of the firefighting community gathered at his grave to honor the man they say is gone but never forgotten.

item.title: Durham pizzeria employee indicted on first-degree murder charge in fatal co-worker shooting
item.description: A state grand jury has formally charged Isaiah Rawlinson, 30, with first-degree murder in the death of his former co-worker. The indictment was handed down on Monday, according to Durham superior court records.

item.title: GoRaleigh bus shot into on West Garner Road, police say
item.description: The Garner Police Department said a shooting happened on West Garner Road and a GoRaleigh bus was hit by gunfire.
